title.narrative: Supporting stronger results for DFID Security, Justice and Conflict Programme

description.narrative: This activity Supporting stronger results for DFID Security, Justice and Conflict Programme is a component of Conflict, Crime and Violence Results Initiative (CCVRI) reported by FCDO with a funding type of 111 - Not for profit organisation and a budget of £1,618,678. This project benefits Developing countries, unspecified. It works in the following sector(s): Civilian peace-building, conflict prevention and resolution.
